steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each target is matched to its result and its baseline. A miss of more than 5 percent needs an action.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 energy target missed with no action

findings.title: Target missed by more than 5 percent with no action
findings.fix: Set the action for the next quarter

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] target-steam.md:12  Target missed by more than 5 percent with no action.
       Fix: Set the action for the next quarter.
[medium] next-q-action-2.md:19  Next-quarter action with no measure.
       Fix: Add the measure.
[low] target-lighting.md:26  Target with no baseline.
       Fix: Record the baseline.
Not checked: Energy supply contracts.
pros: Checks a target missed by more than 5 percent with no action, a target with no baseline, and a next-quarter action with no measure.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-energy-target-review skill on the records for this review.
